hyponastic.definition:
a. Exhibiting a downward convexity caused by unequal
   growth. Cf. Epinastic.

hyponasty.definition:
n. Downward convexity, or convexity of the inferior
   surface.

hyponatremia.definition: n. abnormally low level of sodium in the blood; associated with dehydration
hyponatremia.translation:
n. 血钠过少, 低钠血症, 低钠血
[医] 血钠过少, 低钠血

hyponeocytosis.translation: [医] 幼稚[白]细胞性白细胞过少[症]

hyponitremia.translation: [医] 血氮过少, 低氮血

hyponitrite.definition: n. A salt of hyponitrous acid.

hyponitrous.definition:
a. Containing or derived from nitrogen having a lower
   valence than in nitrous compounds.

hyponitrous acid.translation:
[化] 连二次硝酸(H-2N-2O-3)
[医] 次氮酸, 次硝酸

hyponoderma.translation: [医] 幼虫移行病, 游走性幼虫病

hyponoia.translation: n. [医]精神迟钝, 思想迟缓

hyponomoderma.translation: [医] 幼虫移行病, 游走性幼虫病

hyponomous.translation: [医] 穿掘性的, 深蚀的(溃疡)

hyponym.definition: n. a word that is more specific than a given word

hyponymy.definition: n the semantic relation of being subordinate or belonging to a lower rank or class
hyponymy.translation: n. [语](词义之间的)下义关系,上下位关系
